Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full care-options payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"How would you like to get care?","subtitle":"Choose the option that fits your needs","options":[{"id":"o1","channel":"nurse_line","label":"24/7 Nurse Advice Line","description":"Talk to a registered nurse now","meta":"Avg wait 3 min","actionType":"call","actionValue":"+18005551234"},{"id":"o2","channel":"video","label":"Video visit","description":"See a provider by video in about 15 minutes","meta":"$0 with your plan","actionType":"link","actionValue":"https://example.com/video-visit","recommended":true},{"id":"o3","channel":"in_person","label":"Schedule an in-person visit","description":"Book a time at a clinic near you","actionType":"book","actionValue":"Schedule an in-person visit"},{"id":"o4","channel":"er","label":"Emergency care","description":"For severe or life-threatening symptoms","actionType":"call","actionValue":"911"}],"disclaimer":"If this is a medical emergency, call 911. This tool does not provide medical advice.","submitText":"Continue"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading; defaults to 'How would you like to get care?'.
- 'subtitle' (string, optional): a short line under the title.
- 'options' (array, REQUIRED, at least two objects): the care channels. Each MUST have 'id' (string, unique), 'label' (string, short) and 'actionType' (string; one of 'call','link','book'). Optional per option: 'channel' (string; one of 'nurse_line','video','in_person','urgent','er','pharmacy','message' — drives the icon/hue; defaults to 'message'); 'description' (string, one short line); 'meta' (string, a small tag like 'Avg wait 3 min' or '$0 with your plan'); 'recommended' (boolean — highlights the option and adds a Recommended ribbon); 'actionValue' (string): for actionType 'call' a phone number (E.164 like '+18005551234', or '911'); for 'link' a full https URL (opens in a new tab); for 'book' a short instruction sent back to the agent to continue the conversation (e.g. 'Schedule an in-person visit').
- 'disclaimer' (string, optional but recommended): a safety line shown at the bottom with an alert icon.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): reserved; safe to omit.

Do NOT include or ask for symptoms or any patient health information in this payload. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
